request:
镜头 s30：纪录片现场纪实镜头，时长 9 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
年代与画面风格（detailed_description 第一行照此英文书写）：raw verite documentary footage shot handheld in 2075 on a high-ISO full-frame documentary camera in available light only: visible sensor noise, deep solid blacks, volumetric haze and silhouettes, true-to-life skin tones, focus occasionally hunting
该类型的纪录片默认机位：fly-on-the-wall documentary camera, shoulder-mounted handheld with small reframings, operator reacting late
导演意图（自然语言）：手持，跟拍，晃动。指挥大厅里警报灯一闪一闪，调度员们乱成一片。宋念戴着耳机站在操作台前，慢慢抬起头，看向大屏中央那枚红色镜头。环境声：警报声、此起彼伏听不清的呼叫声。
情绪：frantic, tense, foreboding
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：medium shot, handheld follow with a nervous shake
景深与虚实：Natural depth of field; Nian sharp, the operators around her blurred by motion.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Raw verité in the underground city's command hall during the Jupiter crisis: Nian, 33, in a dark grey dispatcher uniform with a headset, stands at her console among frantic operators, alarm lights pulsing, looking up at the red lens high on the display wall. Blocking lock: Nian stands at her console at frame centre-left, operators move around her at frame left and right, the display wall with the red lens fills the upper background.
Picture 2: Nian (Song's daughter, dispatch engineer, 33 in 2075, 36 in 2078) (character reference; role: the daughter, now grown up). A Chinese woman in her mid-thirties, dispatch engineer of an underground city: straight black shoulder-length hair tucked behind her ears with short side-swept bangs, calm guarded tired eyes, faint lines, a round face grown lean. Dark grey dispatcher uniform jacket with a high collar, a light headset around her neck.
Picture 3: the administration command hall (location reference; role: location reference). Interior of the administration command centre of an underground city: a tiered control hall with rows of consoles and operators seen from behind, a giant dark display wall showing only abstract maps and graphs, and high in the middle of the wall a single round red-glowing camera lens of the central AI. Cold blue-white light.
Picture 4: MOSS terminal (black AI terminal with one red glowing lens) (character reference; role: the central AI's physical presence). Close view of an artificial-intelligence monitoring terminal built into a brushed-steel wall panel of a control hall: a black glass housing with a single round camera lens glowing deep red in its centre, a thin ring of red light around it, faint reflections of people in the glass. Cold, clinical, perfectly clean in contrast with the worn surroundings.
本镜头没有台词。
现场环境声：blaring alarms, overlapping indistinct Mandarin radio calls, footsteps
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。

Blocking at the start: Nian at her console at frame centre-left in profile, two operators crossing at frame left, another turning at frame right, the blurred shoulder of a man in the near foreground at frame right, the dark display wall and its red lens high in the background. Start: Nian stands braced over the console, headset on, one hand flat on the desk edge, the alarm light washing her face red then blue-white then red again. Middle: around her the operators rise and swing between consoles, a shoulder passes through the near foreground and blurs out, the camera sways with the operator's breathing and loses her for a heartbeat before finding her again; Nian's hand slides off the desk, her shoulders settle, and she lifts her chin, eyes travelling up past the consoles to the display wall. End: her head is fully raised, face lifted toward the red lens high in the background, the pulsing red light steady in her eyes, her lips slightly parted, and she holds that upward look as the camera settles on her. Mood: frantic, tense, foreboding. Blur: Nian's face and the headset stay sharp while the operators around her smear into moving blue-grey shapes; the display wall and the red lens sit soft in the background, its glow blooming through the haze. No character speaks any line in this shot; any human voices are indistinct, unintelligible Mandarin Chinese walla only. Hold the last frame.

Blaring two-tone alarms over a deep room rumble, overlapping indistinct Mandarin radio calls and shouted walla, footsteps and chair legs scraping concrete, a console buzzing, headset cable brushing fabric, breath close to the microphone; raw production location sound only, dry and unscored, no background music.
